environment_notes: Restricted sandbox blocks some cross-thread asyncio wakeups and HTTP loopback fixtures. The complete worker run cited above ran outside that sandbox. The corrected three-test subset and backend suite used an external test-only periodic selector wakeup; no tasks, parser results or assertions were replaced.
A subsequent sandbox full-run attempt has environment-only socket/CLI failures and is not counted as a clean run. Temporary test helpers and raw evidence are outside the repository.

initial_native_attempt.corrections: Verifier originally omitted recursive OOXML parts/context-only YARA and assumed high risk for a medium-risk external relationship. Macro scan trees exceeded the test-only 120-second budget. Fixed the independent inventory/status/risk expectations and used a 300-second test budget; fixtures and analysis runtime unchanged.

limitations: Modern encrypted OOXML only; legacy encrypted binary DOC/XLS/PPT, IRM and other crypto remain unsupported/partial.
Agile requires HMAC; Standard only has verifier, ZIP CRC and structural checks, with no authenticated integrity.
Synthetic macro packages preserve inert VBA/embedding bytes but deliberately have no parseable VBA source: partial is expected.

External-template control is 53/medium on the decrypted child, inherited 15/low on encrypted parent with local score 0; it does not exercise the high-risk floor. Native PDF v2 retains high-risk 84 propagation coverage.
Conservative CFB layout validation can reject unusual valid files as partial.
Synthetic tests do not estimate real-world detection accuracy or prove cloud rollout, billing, retention or CAPE execution.
